_comment: Reviewed floor for the Rasuwa-Bhotekoshi flood. Deaths currently NDRRMA / MoHA, 17 Bhadra 09:00 (348+217+190+155+66+59+38+41 = 1114). Uncontacted 3,916. Injured 292 (210 discharged + 79 still in treatment + 3 died in care) / deployed 21,314 / NDRRMA rescued graphic 11,993. The ten-minute cycle reads nirajbhusal.github.io/rasuwa-flood-bulletin and merge_sitrep replaces a group only when its parts add up; a failed scrape leaves these numbers standing. Deaths never go down — Police 1,127 (including 9 in India) and a lagging compilation must not put 1,003 back over NDRRMA 1114. The overview also shows live government figures beside this grid (BIPAD corridor incidents, NDRRMA rescued-persons totals, OPMCM portal counters); those come straight from the portals and are never merged into these numbers. Two rules govern edits. (1) Never sum across groups that the source keeps apart - the `exclusive` flags and `do_not_merge` notes exist because several of these counts overlap, and adding them would invent casualties. (2) Every breakdown must sum to its own stated total; app/domains/flood/merge.py re-adds them at load and the page shows a warning if either stops reconciling. Do not add Tibet (16 dead) or India's 9 onto Nepal's 1114.

notes.body_en: Kathmandu DEOC still lists 88 injured brought to valley hospitals as a separate collection from the official 292. Kathmandu District Police said on 31 August that 33 of 48 patients at the National Trauma Centre had been discharged and 15 remained in care. Police assistance desks are at Bir Hospital and the Trauma Centre. These hospital counts are not added to the 292.
notes.body_ne: काठमाडौं डीईओसीले उपत्यकाका अस्पतालमा ल्याइएका ८८ घाइतेलाई आधिकारिक २९२ भन्दा छुट्टै संकलनका रूपमा राखेको छ। काठमाडौं जिल्ला प्रहरीले ३१ अगस्टमा राष्ट्रिय ट्रमा सेन्टरका ४८ मध्ये ३३ डिस्चार्ज र १५ उपचाररत रहेको बताएको छ। प्रहरी सहयोग डेस्क वीर अस्पताल र ट्रमा सेन्टरमा छन्। यी अस्पताल गणना २९२ मा जोडिँदैनन्।

notes.body_en: More than 100 homes damaged. Five to seven houses left standing in the bazaar. More than 300 people were waiting for rescue.
notes.body_ne: १०० भन्दा बढी घरमा क्षति। बजारमा ५–७ घर मात्र बाँकी। ३०० भन्दा बढी उद्धारको प्रतीक्षामा थिए।

notes.body_en: 26 staff across 8 banks. Branches were washed away at Timure, Syaphrubesi and Betrawati.
notes.body_ne: ८ बैंकका २६ कर्मचारी। टिमुरे, स्याफ्रुबेंसी र बेत्रावतीमा शाखा बगे।

notes.body_en: About 1,000 inmates are safe. The building at Bidur-3 is damaged.
notes.body_ne: करिब १,००० कैदी सुरक्षित छन्। बिदुर-३ को भवनमा क्षति भएको छ।

notes.title_en: Rs 1 billion from the PM fund, to be sent
notes.body_en: The Prime Minister's Disaster Relief Fund operating committee decided on 16 Bhadra to send Rs 1 billion immediately to flood-affected areas. That is a disbursement from the fund, not extra cash on top of the Rs 7.15 billion already in the banks. Source: Office of the Prime Minister on nepal.gov.np.
notes.body_ne: प्रधानमन्त्री दैवी प्रकोप उद्धार कोष सञ्चालन समितिले १६ भदौमा बाढी प्रभावित क्षेत्रमा एक अर्ब तत्काल पठाउने निर्णय गरेको छ। यो कोषबाट बाहिरिने रकम हो, बैंकमा रहेको ७ अर्ब १५ करोडमाथि थप होइन। स्रोत: प्रधानमन्त्री कार्यालय, nepal.gov.np।

notes.body_en: The monsoon response command at the Ministry of Home Affairs decided on 16 Bhadra to send Rs 6.75 crore to 15 palikas in Rasuwa, Nuwakot, Dhading, Gorkha and Tanahun. That matches an allocation the DRRM executive committee made on 11 Bhadra — count it once, and do not add it onto the Prime Minister's fund cash total. Source: MoHA on nepal.gov.np.
notes.body_ne: गृह मन्त्रालयको मनसुन प्रतिकार्य कमाण्डले १६ भदौमा रसुवा, नुवाकोट, धादिङ, गोरखा र तनहुँका १५ पालिकालाई ६ करोड ७५ लाख पठाउने निर्णय गरेको छ। यो ११ भदौको विपद् कार्यकारी समितिको विनियोजनसँग मेल खान्छ — एक पटक मात्र गन्नुहोस्, प्रधानमन्त्री कोषको मौज्दातमाथि नजोड्नुहोस्। स्रोत: गृह मन्त्रालय, nepal.gov.np।

name_lists.do_not_merge_en: Eight lists, published separately by different offices. The same person can appear on more than one, so they are never added into a single rescue total. The official injured figure stays 292. NDRRMA's graphic of 11,993 rescued is a separate count from these named lists.
name_lists.do_not_merge_ne: आठ सूची, फरक-फरक कार्यालयले छुट्टै प्रकाशित गरेका। एउटै व्यक्ति एकभन्दा बढी सूचीमा पर्न सक्छ, त्यसैले यी एउटै उद्धार जम्मामा जोडिँदैनन्। आधिकारिक घाइते संख्या २९२ नै रहन्छ। एनडीआरआरएमएको उद्धार ग्राफिक ११,९९३ यी नामावलीभन्दा छुट्टै गणना हो।
